• Dentist credentials and specializations

• Treatments and pricing
• Clinic accreditation/licensing information
• Whether reviews look authentic
• Reputation for implants, veneers, crowns, root canals, etc.
• How it compares with other Bali dental clinics
If you're considering getting  significant dental work done there , I can also do a deeper due-diligence check rather than just summarizing their marketing.
